sentences.text: An anomaly appears. Now the investigation has to move—fast, with the right evidence in reach!
That signal can begin anywhere: optics, stages, sensors, equipment, or service logs.
Mistral Studio brings it together in one controlled investigation—from the very first step.
Diagnostics, maintenance history, engineering documentation, and prior cases connect in seconds.
Every source stays linked, so engineers can verify every claim immediately.
Then the workflow turns that evidence into a concise, actionable diagnostic brief.
It spots supporting signals, surfaces conflicts, and shows exactly what is still missing.
Not enough confidence? It pauses and asks for more evidence—no guessing.
Now the engineer takes control: review the reasoning, challenge it, and add operational judgment.
Only the approved action moves forward, with uncertainty visible at every step.
Sources, retries, decisions, approvals—everything stays visible and traceable in Studio.
And here’s the opportunity: map one high-value ASML workflow, align the evidence and approvals, and launch a measurable pilot—with clear success measures from day one!
